workspace.storage.label: Storage
workspace.storage.about: Free and cached space, and the cache budget.

workspace.cache_care.label: Cache tidying
workspace.cache_care.about: When the seam worker is idle it removes crash leftovers, caches of removed or changed songs, seams from an older engine and stems unused for two weeks, shares identical clips, and compacts the library file. The current mix is never touched.

workspace.song_audio_cache.label: Song audio cache
workspace.song_audio_cache.about: A whole song asked for on its own is decoded once into the render cache and served from there, with Range and a tag from its source file. It counts toward the cache limit and goes least recently used first; the current mix's seams are never pushed out for it. Off, each request decodes the song again.

workspace.backup.label: Local backup
workspace.backup.about: Back up the library's data and restore it on the next start.

workspace.diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
workspace.diagnostics.about: The raw details of what Selecta is doing, for when something goes wrong.

workspace.library_health.label: Library health
workspace.library_health.about: Overview says whether the library can be mixed or what blocks it, and which one thing to do first.

workspace.self_service.label: What went wrong
workspace.self_service.about: Faults Selecta has measured on this PC, each with its confirmed or possible cause and a scoped way to put it right.
